newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Leo Shield sets 40 mln share placement.
newsitem.headline: Leo Shield sets 40 mln share placement.

text.p: Leo Shield Exploration Ltd said on Monday that shareholders had approved the placement of up to 40 million shares at 20 cents each, raising up to A$8 million.

Institutional investors and major shareholders had agreed to take up 30 million of the shares, which carry free attaching options exercisable at 25 cents each. The other 10 million shares have been reserved for shareholders, the company said.
